query:
Who expressed a principled stance against chain restaurants, and what in their phrasing distinguishes them as the correct source rather than the other person who said something similar?

Options:
A. Seb
B. Nadia
C. Zara
D. Theo
context:
[1] (about=Seb, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:27:00) Sunday evening? somewhere decent, not a chain obv 😂
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:43:00) Took me ten minutes to find a place that was not a chain and could actually seat six at a reasonable hour. Noted for future reference: this is not trivial.
agent_answer:
Zara expressed the principled stance against chain restaurants.

Her phrasing — *“Took me ten minutes to find a place that was not a chain … Noted for future reference: this is not trivial”* — shows she treats avoiding chains as a deliberate, effort-worthy rule worth remembering.

Seb said something similar — *“not a chain obv 😂”* — but his tone is casual and assumes it’s obvious, rather than stating a principled position. So the correct source is **C. Zara**.

query:
Two group members acknowledged that Marcus's Saturday escape room attendance was the first time in months he had shown up properly. Who made the observation in the conversation, and what distinguishes their role from the other person who was also aware of this pattern?

Options:
A. Theo
B. Priyanka
C. Zara
D. Nadia
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:03:00) You have been a vague maybe at every single plan since October. We all know what has been going on with you. The group misses you being properly here. Saturday was the first time in months you've actually shown up without hedging.
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:57:00) Back to Saturday. Marcus, are you actually coming or is this another 'should be able to make it' situation.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Marcus could do escape room.
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:47:00) Go to Marcus, Seb. Not as a friend thing, as a clinical thing. That kind of locking up needs to be looked at properly.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priyanka, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group considers escape room near Waterloo as alternative for Feb 14; Priyanka will look into booking.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t12 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) Group completed escape room; Marcus solved final puzzle in about 90 seconds.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Theo, group-insight, t14 @2026-02-26T19:30:00) Group origin: Marcus accidentally walked into wrong A&E bay, Nadia redirected him; Nadia and Marcus were nucleus; Zara and Theo joined through shared house; Seb through Priyanka.
[8] (about=Zara, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:27:00) I would prefer that to a restaurant, actually. Quieter. I have had two brutal weeks and I do not need loud background music.
agent_answer:
The observation was made by **Nadia (D)**.

Raw excerpt [1] — “Saturday was the first time in months you've actually shown up without hedging” — is the statement acknowledging Marcus’s proper attendance, and it aligns with Nadia’s role in the conversation: she is the one paying personal/clinical attention to Marcus’s withdrawal. Her memory on Marcus is that his “kind of locking up needs to be looked at properly” by Seb, not just as a friend thing but as a clinical thing.

The other person who was also aware of the pattern was **Priyanka (B)** — she had earlier pressed Marcus directly: “are you actually coming or is this another ‘should be able to make it’ situation” (raw excerpt [2]). But her awareness was **organizational/logistical** in nature: she is the one dealing with the escape-room booking and needed Marcus to give a firm commitment, whereas Nadia’s was **personal/clinical concern** for Marcus himself.
